economics.scope_interpretation: These are deterministic commission reductions only after a qualifying order fills in the exact role. They are not trading alpha, fill probability, spread capture, or authority to change the strategy's quote asset.

all_required_before_crediting_savings: The trade and its maker or taker role were independently selected by an after-cost organic strategy before this overlay is credited.
The exact base and quote pair is present in a fresh current official promotion table and is available to the account and region.

FDUSD U or USD1 is already the independently required quote and settlement asset; no acquisition conversion borrowing deposit retention or additional leg is permitted merely to reach the promotional pair.
A maker saving is credited only to an actual maker fill and a taker saving only to an actual taker fill.
A fresh exact-order commission estimate and owned fill reconciliation establish the effective account symbol role special commission tax and discount treatment before scaling.
Execution price spread depth queue fill probability adverse selection settlement inventory and quote-asset basis remain inside the independently justified strategy's own bounds.
precedence_and_non_overlap: Never apply a BNB discount to a zero commission or credit both the zero-fee saving and the BNB saving to the same fee component.
For a zero-maker-only pair the maker component is zero; any taker BNB treatment is separate and must come from exact account evidence.
For a zero-maker-and-taker promotion Binance states that BNB discounts referral rebates and other adjustments do not apply to the promotional volume.
The USDC taker rate may use the published BNB-adjusted rate only when the account's BNB fee setting and exact order evidence independently qualify.

limitations: The official fee page is dynamic and the promotions are current until changed or withdrawn; a fresh same-page check is mandatory at use time.
Public tables do not prove exact account region pair or tax eligibility and no signed commission endpoint was called.
Zero commission cannot compensate for a worse executable price spread queue position fill probability adverse selection stablecoin basis or extra conversion leg.
VIP2 through VIP9 benefits are conditional on an already-existing tier. This artifact forbids trading or holding BNB merely to create or retain VIP status.
The U announcement source initially documented BTC/U; the current official fee table is the source for the later displayed ETH/U and SOL/U promotional rows.
The overlay can reduce a direct cost on organic flow but cannot make a standalone profit guarantee or prove long-run strategy profitability.

switching quote assets without a source-bound executable all-cost comparison
